message.content: {"note_claim": "Melilla was conquered by Spain in 1497, long before Morocco's independence in 1956, and is not part of Morocco's territory.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Melilla was occupied on 17 September 1497, virtually without violence as it was on the border between the Kingdom of Tlemcen and the Kingdom of Fez, and as a result had been fought over many times and left abandoned.", "reason": "The page directly substantiates the 1497 Spanish takeover of Melilla and also notes Morocco's independence in 1956, so it supports the Melilla claims in the note."}

parsed.note_claim: Melilla was conquered by Spain in 1497, long before Morocco's independence in 1956, and is not part of Morocco's territory.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Melilla was occupied on 17 September 1497, virtually without violence as it was on the border between the Kingdom of Tlemcen and the Kingdom of Fez, and as a result had been fought over many times and left abandoned.
parsed.reason: The page directly substantiates the 1497 Spanish takeover of Melilla and also notes Morocco's independence in 1956, so it supports the Melilla claims in the note.
